certification_gate_for_a_future_engine_v.effect: a certified source may only be used by a NEW locked engine version; never retroactively

availability_capture.exploratory_prior_observations: do not qualify and are not used

candidate_universe: V1/V2 universe: players who appeared for the team in its last 10 usable prior team games; unobservable participants (call-ups, trades) get no forecast and are counted at grading
clean_boundary: only forecasts generated after the engine-lock commit is pushed, for games whose horizon cutoff is at/after the lock's eligible_from_cutoff_utc, are clean forward evidence. Earlier 2026 games are never backfilled or scored.

forecast_time: Phase0 simple central baseline (prior-10 same-season mean, stored at forecast time)
Phase0 competent-human baseline (stored at forecast time, constants in the lock)
grading_time: current production SOG>=3 classifier from docs/nhl_picks_log.jsonl on origin/main, accepted only if logged_at < cutoff

engine_freeze.fit: fixed B2 per horizon fit on targets 2018-2025 (T24H, T90, T30 rows built with that horizon's cutoff)
engine_freeze.history_updates: completed 2026 games enter rolling player/team history features at forecast time (retrieved at or before the cutoff); coefficients never change
engine_freeze.new_engine_version_requires: a new lock commit before its own first forecast; v1.0 forecasts are never altered

evidence_standards.first_confirmatory_look: not before 28 calendar days of valid forecasts AND at least 15000 graded MEANINGFUL player-games at that horizon
evidence_standards.outcome_of_primary_met: FORWARD_CONFIRMATION_CANDIDATE only; any promotion is a separate human decision; nothing is promoted by this protocol
evidence_standards.primary: MEANINGFUL population, T90, game-macro CRPS of B2 vs the frozen human baseline (Poisson), relative improvement >= 0.5% with 2-calendar-week moving-block bootstrap (10000 reps) one-sided 95% upper bound < 0
secondary_must_not_fail: central MAE(mean) not worse than the best simple baseline by more than 1%
80% and 90% interval coverage error not worse than the human baseline by more than 0.02

thresholds: P(SOG>=1..5): Brier, Brier skill vs frozen base-rate comparator, calibration, ECE, observed vs predicted

grader.CLEAN: RAW minus entries of censor_registry.jsonl (allowed reasons: IN_GAME_INJURY_ABNORMAL_LOST_ICE_TIME, EJECTION_OR_MISCONDUCT_ABNORMAL_EXIT, each with documented evidence); never poor shooting, ordinary benching, demotion, score effects, coaching decisions
grader.large_miss_forensics: |actual-expected|>3 classified only by the fixed diagnostic ratios of phase1a_sog_protocol.json; postgame values are diagnostics
grader.official_sog: stats-REST skater summary shots (shootout excluded); a forecast player with no official row has played=0 and SOG=0
grader.scores_only_after: official final state with player rows

ledger.hash_chain: each row carries prev_hash and row_hash = sha256(canonical json without row_hash); genesis prev_hash = 64 zeros
ledger.immutability: verified by tests (chain) and by git history (every commit only appends); raw payloads are content-addressed gz blobs under blobs/

scheduling_limitation: GitHub scheduled workflows run only from the default branch and this branch must not be merged, so continuous forecasting cannot be automated from this branch; the workflow here is workflow_dispatch-only and forecasts exist only for windows in which a run actually happened; every other window is recorded MISSED_CUTOFF by the next run

validity_window.early: runs before the window do not forecast
validity_window.late: INVALID_LATE row (audit evidence only) - never used as pregame information
validity_window.missed: MISSED_CUTOFF row written once, never backfilled
validity_window.rule: a forecast is valid only if generated_at is inside [cutoff - 900 s, cutoff] and every retrieval it used completed at or before the cutoff and the cutoff >= eligible_from_cutoff_utc
